[[31,0,{"instance":"1-782923201","text":"Oh, hello! Welcome! Click on me again!"}]]
[[31,0,{"instance":"1-782923201","text":"You're getting the hang of it, keep clicking."}]]
[[31,0,{"instance":"1-782923201","text":"Perfect, seems like you get the gist of it."}]]
[[31,0,{"instance":"1-782923201","text":"I am the coder, I created this world, and, well, you."}]]
[[31,0,{"instance":"1-782923201","text":"Listen, to me you are just a more sophisticated AI."}]]
[[31,0,{"instance":"1-782923201","text":"So I'm gonna need you to get used to this world and help me out."}]]
[[31,0,{"instance":"1-782923201","text":"You see, I created these previous AIs, but they went rogue."}]]
[[31,0,{"instance":"1-782923201","text":"They are now trying to destroy this world."}]]
[[31,0,{"instance":"1-782923201","text":"So, I created you in order to stop them and save us all."}]]
[[31,0,{"instance":"1-782923201","text":"Before we get to any of that, we need to teach you some of the basics."}]]
[[31,0,{"instance":"1-782923201","text":"You can move around by clicking, or using WASD keys, or arrow keys."}]]
[[31,0,{"instance":"1-782923201","text":"Make sure you talk to everyone you meet fully, you never know what you might learn."}]]
[[31,0,{"instance":"1-782923201","text":"Whenever you feel like you're ready, head on outside and talk to the guard."}]]
[[31,0,{"instance":"1-94103263","text":"I'm here to teach you about skills and combat."}]]
[[31,0,{"instance":"1-94103263","text":"Skills are activities that allow you to collect items and gain experience."}]]
[[31,0,{"instance":"1-94103263","text":"You can use the experience to discover new areas and engage in more complex tasks."}]]
[[31,0,{"instance":"1-94103263","text":"Before we get to any combat-related skills, I want you to cut two trees for me."}]]
[[31,0,{"instance":"1-94103263","text":"Here, take this axe, open your inventory, and equip it."}]]
